name: ReadMe
description: ReadMe is a developer-friendly API documentation platform that combines a visual editor with AI-powered tools to help teams create, manage, and publish technical/API documentation.
best_for: Positioned for "teams who know good docs drive adoption" — API teams, technical writers, and developer-facing product teams, ranging from individual developers (free Starter tier) to large enterprises needing SSO/compliance (Enterprise tier).
features: Interactive API reference/explorer generated from OpenAPI specs
WYSIWYG editor supporting Markdown, OpenAPI, and MDX
AI tools that draft doc updates from pull requests, plus a writing/linting assistant
Bi-directional Git sync (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab) with branching/approval workflows
SSO (Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta), SOC2/GDPR compliance, audit logs

alternatives.name: Document360
alternatives.description: An AI-powered knowledge base platform for internal and external documentation, SOPs, and API docs.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams, technical writers, and product/engineering teams needing a broad-purpose knowledge base.

alternatives.name: Archbee
alternatives.description: A knowledge portal platform for turning documentation into searchable, interactive customer-facing portals.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams building customer self-service docs to cut support tickets.
